Funasr-Punctuation-Restore v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides one-click punctuation restoration for text, single files, or entire directories using FunASR ct-punc model.
- Supports Chinese-English mixed text with the punc_ct-transformer_cn-en-common-vocab471067-large model.
- Automatically creates a punctuated output (file or directory), preserving the original files.
- Supports GPU acceleration and automated GPU memory management.
- Easy execution: automatically handles virtual environment setup and runs with python3 or python as fallback.
